items.title: Latitude and Longitudinal Path Planning in Autonomous Vehicle
items.objective: Design and implement control algorithms for precise lateral and longitudinal path planning in autonomous vehicles.
items.implementation: Designed and implemented control algorithms for lateral and longitudinal path planning using MATLAB and Python. Applied the MATLAB Autonomous Driving Toolbox for simulation and validation.

items.title: Prospects of Retrofitting ICE Vehicles to EVs in Nepal
items.objective: Assess the feasibility and policy landscape for converting internal combustion engine vehicles to electric vehicles in Nepal.
items.problem: Nepal's growing transportation emissions and reliance on imported fossil fuels necessitate a transition strategy to EVs, but retrofitting feasibility is underexplored in the local context.
items.implementation: Conducted a comparative study of 12 international case studies from Europe, North America, and Asia. Developed actionable policy recommendations on EV infrastructure, cost-benefit models, and retrofitting methods for Nepal.
items.results: Produced a policy recommendation document covering EV infrastructure requirements, cost-benefit analysis, and a phased retrofitting roadmap for Nepal.

items.title: Design and Development of Low-Cost Fuel Cell Hybrid Scooter
items.objective: Design and develop a low-cost fuel cell hybrid scooter by modeling hybrid powertrain systems and analyzing frame structures.
items.implementation: Modeled hybrid powertrain systems in MATLAB. Analyzed vehicle frame structures for structural integrity and lightweight design.

items.title: Design and Fabrication of a Prototype SCARA Robot
items.objective: Design and fabricate a prototype SCARA robot capable of pick-and-place operations with Arduino-based control.
items.control: Implemented Arduino-based control with potentiometers for actuation of the SCARA arm joints.
items.results: Achieved 800g payload capacity, 30cm working arc, and 15cm vertical reach — fully functional for pick-and-place operations.
